Privacy Policy
Last updated: 01.05.2026
PetCorner respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.
1. Information We Collect We may collect the following types of information: - Account Information: email address and username (via Firebase Authentication) - User Content: posts, services, listings, images, and descriptions - Location Data: approximate or precise location (only with your permission) - Device Information: device model and operating system
2. How We Use Your Information We use your data to: - manage your account - display your posts and services - show nearby services on the map - improve app performance and experience
3. Third-Party Services We use third-party services including: - Firebase (Authentication and Database) - Google Maps
These services may process your data according to their own privacy policies.
4. Data Sharing We do not sell your personal data. Your posted content may be visible to other users in the app.
5. Data Storage and Security Your data is securely stored using Firebase services. We take reasonable steps to protect your data.
6. Location Permissions The app may request location access to show your position and nearby services. You can disable this anytime in your device settings.
7. Data Deletion You can request deletion of your account and data by contacting us.
8. Contact Us If you have any questions, contact us at: martirosyannoro44@gmail.com
